import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"cedarschema\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("entity User;", config)
